Container.Name: kongflix-metadata
Container.Overview: Scans a Jellyfin server for items missing a poster image or overview/plot text, and triggers Jellyfin's own metadata refresh for those items so its configured providers (TMDb, TVDB, etc.) can fill in the gaps. Does not call any external metadata provider itself. Supports a scheduled scan (cron), a one-off manual scan, or a continuous watch mode that reacts to newly added library items.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Jellyfin server, including port.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: API key created in Jellyfin under Dashboard -> API Keys.

Config.Name: Run Mode
Config.Description: How the scan is triggered: schedule (cron, runs immediately then on schedule), once (single scan then exit), or watch (reacts to newly added items).

Config.Name: Cron Schedule
Config.Description: Cron expression used only in schedule mode. Container runs in UTC.

Config.Name: Max Refreshes Per Run
Config.Description: Caps how many items get a refresh triggered per scan run, so a large or music-heavy library isn't hammered on the first run.

Config.Name: Log Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container where the summary log file is written.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Host path for the container's log output.
